title: My Hero Academia Unveils First Look At Exciting New Release For November
content: After running for nine years, the beloved anime adaptation of My Hero Academia reached its conclusion in December 2025. Kohei Horikoshi’s hit Weekly Shonen Jump manga etched its name into history as one of the best-selling series of all time, with over 100 million copies in circulation across the globe.
